description: Look up one of the 64 I Ching hexagrams (King Wen sequence) by its number (1-64) or by name (Chinese, pinyin, or the English gloss used in this pack). Returns the full hexagram: binary lines, upper/lower trigram, judgment, image, all six line texts, and keywords, each in original wording referencing James Legge’s 1899 translation as the public-domain source.

name.description: Hexagram name: Chinese characters, pinyin (with or without tone marks), or English gloss, e.g. "Qian", "乾", "Pure Yang".

name: get_hexagram
title: Get Hexagram
